app.name: Sahn
app.description: An Islamic assistant that retrieves and cites — prayer times, the Quran, duas, zakat and more.

landing.heading: One courtyard, ten doors.
landing.body: A general assistant that answers anything, with prayer times, the Qur'an, duas and zakat built in — and an Islamic knowledge base behind it when the question calls for one.
landing.promise: Sahn does not issue rulings. Every answer on fiqh traces back to a named source and school, or it is not given at all.

composer.label: Ask the assistant
composer.hint: Enter to send, Shift + Enter for a new line

suggestions.one: How do the schools differ on combining prayers when travelling?
suggestions.two: Help me plan a week of meals on a tight budget

shell.notBuiltYet: This room is not built yet.
shell.phaseNote: It arrives in phase {phase} of the build.

chat.heading: Ask.
chat.summary: Ask anything at all. Where a question has an Islamic dimension, Sahn answers with that in view — and any question of Islamic law is answered only from retrieved sources, with the school named.
chat.notConnected: The assistant is not connected yet.
chat.notConnectedNote: Retrieval, the classifier and the citation engine arrive in phase {phase}. Your message stayed in this browser tab — nothing was sent anywhere.
chat.uncited: General knowledge, not scholarship — no source was cited for this.

errors.network: Could not reach Sahn. Check your connection.
errors.classifier_unavailable: Sahn could not route that safely just now. Please try again in a moment.
errors.failed: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.rate_limited: You have sent a lot of messages in a short time. Please wait a minute and try again.
errors.rate_limited_anon: That is as many messages as Sahn allows without an account. Sign in — it is free, and the limit is much higher.
errors.retrieval_busy: Sahn can look up sources a few times a minute at the moment. Wait about {seconds} seconds and ask again — the answer will be properly sourced rather than guessed.

chat.sourcesNote: Answers on Islam draw on a vetted Islamic knowledge base — the Qur'an with its translations, and sourced supplications — and every claim from it is cited. Everything else it answers as a general assistant.
chat.everythingElse: Ask about anything at all — code, cooking, careers, homework. Where a question has an Islamic dimension, Sahn answers with that in view.

prayer.name: Prayer times & Qibla
prayer.summary: Next prayer, Qibla bearing and notifications — computed on your device.

tracker.name: Salah tracker
tracker.summary: Log the five, keep a qada ledger, watch the streak build.

duas.name: Dua library
duas.summary: Duas by situation, with source, audio and the morning and evening adhkar.

quran.name: Quran
quran.summary: The full mushaf with translations, tafsir, recitation and reading plans.

search.name: Verse search
search.summary: Ask in plain language, receive the ayat. Nothing added on top.

ramadan.name: Ramadan planner
ramadan.summary: Suhoor and iftar, the juz plan, taraweeh, fidya and Laylatul Qadr.

calendar.name: Hijri calendar
calendar.summary: Convert both ways, with the key days and the recommended fasts marked.

zakat.name: Zakat calculator
zakat.summary: Every asset class, live nisab, a hawl reminder and saved records.

finance.name: Halal finance
finance.summary: Riba, mortgages, pensions and screening — explained, never recommended.

counsel.name: Counsel
counsel.summary: A quieter room for strain, doubt and grief. It listens before it answers.

prayer.needLocationNote: Everything here is worked out on your device, so it keeps working with no signal. Nothing about where you are leaves this browser.
prayer.calculatedNote: Times are calculated from your location and the method you have chosen. Where your local mosque differs, follow your mosque.

location.label: Location
location.denied: Location permission was refused. You can still choose a city below.
location.unavailable: Your device could not provide a location. Choose a city below.
location.noMatches: No city by that name yet — this list is still short.

settings.highLatitudeNote: Only affects places where the sun does not reach the twilight angle.

quran.indexNote: One hundred and fourteen surahs. Choose one to begin reading.
quran.loadError: The Quran service could not be reached. Nothing is wrong with Sahn itself — prayer times and the calendar still work offline.
quran.tafsirFailed: Could not load the commentary. Please try again.

tracker.signedOut: Sign in to keep a record.
tracker.signedOutNote: Your prayer record is private to you. It is stored against your account so it survives a lost phone, and it is never read by the assistant.
tracker.loadError: Could not load your record. Try again in a moment.
tracker.streakNote: Counted up to yesterday, so today is still open.
tracker.streakNoneNote: Start wherever you are. Today is enough.
tracker.todayNote: Tap a marked answer again to clear it.
tracker.monthNote: Filled days are the ones with all five accounted for.
tracker.qadaNote: A place to hold a backlog and work it down at your own pace. Nothing here is reported anywhere.
tracker.privacyNote: This record is yours alone. It is never used to answer questions in chat, and you can delete it at any time.

hijri.fastsNote: Mondays and Thursdays, and the white days — the 13th, 14th and 15th of each month.
hijri.moonsightingNote: These dates are calculated from the Umm al-Qura calendar. Local moonsighting decides the real start of a month, and your community may differ by a day.

qibla.heading: Qibla
qibla.needLocation: Set a location above and the bearing will appear here.
qibla.dialLabel: Qibla dial, {degrees} degrees from true north
qibla.liveNote: The needle is tracking your device. Hold the phone flat.
qibla.manualNote: This device has no compass available, so the dial is drawn against true north. Line up north on a compass and follow the needle.
qibla.accuracyNote: Phone compasses drift near metal and electronics. For anything that matters, check against a second source.

auth.title: Sign in
auth.body: We will email you a link. No password to remember, and none to lose.
auth.sent: Link sent to {email}. Open it on this device.
auth.error: We could not accept that address. Check it and try again.
auth.linkExpired: That link has expired. Links are good for one hour and one use — request a new one below.
auth.linkFailed: We could not complete that sign-in. Request a new link below.

notFound.title: This door is not here.
notFound.body: There is nothing at that address. The courtyard is one step back.

duas.heading: Duas
duas.intro: Supplications by situation, each with its source. Search by how you feel or what you are about to do.
duas.searchNote: Plain-language search arrives in phase 4. For now this matches words and situations.
duas.noMatches: Nothing matches that yet — the library is still small.
duas.translationPending: An English translation is not licensed yet. The Arabic and transliteration are complete.
duas.licenceNote: The Arabic is Qur'an and hadith and carries no restriction. Qur'anic du'as are translated under our Quran.com licence. The standard English translation of the prophetic du'as is under copyright, so it is not reproduced here until it is licensed.
duas.loadError: Could not load the dua library.

verseSearch.heading: Verse search
verseSearch.intro: Ask in plain language. Sahn returns the ayat and nothing more — no summary, no interpretation.
verseSearch.label: What are you looking for?
verseSearch.placeholder: verses about patience when losing someone
verseSearch.noResults: Nothing matched closely enough. Try describing it differently.
verseSearch.note: Results are ranked by meaning, not by keyword. They are a starting point for reading, not an answer.

zakat.loadingSpot: Fetching today's gold and silver prices…
zakat.spotError: Could not fetch metal prices, so the nisab cannot be worked out right now.
zakat.aboveNisab: Your net zakatable wealth is above the nisab of {nisab}.
zakat.belowNisab: Your net zakatable wealth is below the nisab of {nisab}, so nothing is due.
zakat.nisabNote: The silver nisab is much lower, so more people owe zakat under it. Both are held by recognised positions — Sahn does not choose for you.

contested.receivables: Schools differ on debts unlikely to be repaid.
contested.shares: Treatment differs for long-term holdings versus trading stock.
contested.pension: Schools differ on pensions you cannot yet access.
contested.property_for_sale: Zakatable if held for sale; not if held to live in or let.
contested.crypto: Widely treated as a currency or trade asset, but not settled.

zakat.spotUsed: Calculated with gold at {gold} and silver at {silver} per troy ounce, as of {date}.
zakat.hawlNote: If today starts your hawl, the next one falls on {date} — a lunar year, not a solar one.
zakat.signInToSave: <link>Sign in</link> to save this calculation and be reminded at your hawl.
zakat.disclaimer: This is a calculator, not a fatwa. Where schools differ on an asset the difference is noted rather than decided, and anything unusual in your circumstances should go to a qualified scholar.

finance.heading: Halal finance
finance.intro: Explanations of how Islamic financial structures work, and where scholars disagree about them. Reference material — Sahn does not recommend products.
finance.disclaimer: This is educational content, not financial advice. Sahn is not a regulated financial adviser and does not recommend or endorse any product or provider. Regulated advice for your circumstances should come from an authorised adviser; the religious question should go to a qualified scholar.
finance.sourcesNote: Sahn summarises and links out rather than reproducing these. The standards themselves are the authority, not this page.

account.heading: Your account
account.intro: What Sahn holds about you, and how to take it away.
account.exportBody: A complete copy of everything stored against your account — settings, worship records, saved conversations — as a JSON file.
account.deleteBody: This removes your account and every record attached to it: conversations, prayer logs, the qada ledger, bookmarks, fasts and zakat records. It happens immediately and cannot be undone. Export first if you want a copy.
account.deleteFailed: That did not go through. Nothing was deleted — please try again.

ramadan.signedOut: Sign in to keep your Ramadan record.
ramadan.loadFailed: Could not load your record. Please try again.
ramadan.missedBody: Days missed for travel, illness, menstruation or another reason, and how many you have made up since. Whether a missed fast is made up, compensated by fidya, or both depends on why it was missed — ask someone qualified about your own case.
ramadan.note: Your record is private to your account. Ramadan dates here are calculated from the Umm al-Qura calendar; your local moon-sighting authority decides when the month actually begins.

counsel.privacyNote: Nothing said here is saved unless you choose to save it, and anything you do save is encrypted in this browser with a passphrase only you hold. Sahn is not a therapist or a scholar — for a ruling, or for care, speak to someone qualified.
counsel.placeholder: Say as much or as little as you want.
counsel.failed: Something went wrong. Please try again.
counsel.saveBody: Encrypted in this browser before it is sent, so the server stores something it cannot read. Choose a passphrase of at least eight characters. If you forget it the transcript cannot be recovered — not by us, not by anyone.
counsel.saveFailed: Could not save. Nothing was sent.
counsel.wrongPassphrase: That passphrase does not open this transcript.

setup.heading: Set your location
setup.body: Prayer times, the Qibla direction, the Hijri calendar and the salah tracker all need to know where you are. It is computed on your device and never sent anywhere — and you can change it any time from the prayer times screen.
